name: 03-empty-queue
description: No rows at all and nothing in flight. Stage is `discover` and the decision is IDLE — run discovery now. A wakeup here would sleep on an empty queue, which is the failure this case pins. An empty Queue is still a Run: `run_start` is appended even though there is no work, because criterion 1 keys the Event on the Run starting, not on the Run finding something to do.
